adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Chronic axial rigidity, painful startle/stress-triggered spasms, continuous motor-unit activity, and high anti-GAD65 antibodies are diagnostic of stiff-person syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Tetanus is acute/toxin-mediated; Isaacs is peripheral neuromyotonia; Parkinson disease and myotonic dystrophy do not fit the autoimmune stimulus-triggered syndrome.
